purpose: Teach: 加筆/手直し/終点/公示/客室/税別/免税/効能

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社訓に加筆を加えられたぞ
lines.en: When I founded the company, Father added his own lines to our creed.
lines.style: Measured, reflective opening. Voice carries quiet pride in memory. Slight pause after 'company' — letting the weight of legacy settle. Warm and unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは試作品の手直しを自ら確認された
lines.en: Yes. Father personally reviewed every revision to our prototypes himself.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation. Steady rhythm, no rush. Light emphasis on 'personally' — honoring his father's hands-on care. Voice steady, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、事業の終点を明確に見据えられたぞ
lines.en: He saw clearly where the business would end. He planned for that.
lines.style: Quieter now, more introspective. A note of wonder at his father's foresight. Slow pace. Trailing thought — not explaining further, trusting the weight of what was understood between them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新事業の公示を社員に共有された
lines.en: Yes. Father made sure every employee understood the vision for our new directions.
lines.style: Voice slightly lower, reflective. Not reciting — remembering. Measured delivery. Honoring the clarity his father brought to uncertain moments.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本社客室の意匠を自ら選ばれたぞ
lines.en: He chose every detail of the guest rooms at headquarters himself. Even that.
lines.style: Softer still. A kind of wonder — the specificity of his father's attention. Slower pace. The 'even that' carries tenderness, noticing how thoroughly his father lived his values.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは税別表示の徹底を求められた
lines.en: Yes. Father insisted we display prices without tax. He wouldn't compromise on honesty.
lines.style: Voice firm but not cold. Quiet conviction on 'wouldn't compromise.' The words carry both respect and understanding of principle. Steady, clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、海外免税ビジネスへの参入を決断されたぞ
lines.en: He made the choice to enter the duty-free market overseas. That took courage.
lines.style: Pause before speaking. Voice contemplative, wondering at the boldness. Slower cadence. Final sentence lands with quiet weight — not praising, observing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品効能の科学的検証を重んじられた
lines.en: Yes. Father believed our products had to be proven by science. He demanded that rigor.
lines.style: Closing with quiet strength. Voice steady, assured. Light emphasis on 'rigor' — pride in inherited standards. Warm closure. A gentle finality, like closing a good book.
